body:
# Release Notes: April 20, 2026

The Network360 Team is excited to share the latest updates designed to enhance your experience.

## Fixes

### Overlap Graphs Misaligned in PDF Export

Fixed an issue in **Compare Networks PDF** exports where overlap graph labels and total counts were misaligned and overlapped, causing Delta and **Comparison Network Counts** to appear transposed.

Updated the chart configuration and adjusted font sizing so that the labels render clearly and consistently across UI and PDF. 

### Compare Networks Performance Issue

Improved the performance and stability of the **Compare Networks Module**.
